subject: Re: MAP - acceptance thresholds and staged commit proposal
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@avarobotics.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: rahul.singh@avarobotics.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + TPM targets — initial ask

Monica / team,

Thanks for the MAP draft you sent earlier. We reviewed the milestones and appreciate Redwood's willingness to stagger commitments. A few points from our side before we loop in procurement:

- We want to limit our initial financial exposure during the eval window. Can we start with a 1.5M TPM soft-commit for months 1–2 instead of the 3M proposed?
- If acceptance criteria are met (latency < 180ms p95 and embedding drift < 2% on the supplied test set), we will scale to 6M TPM in month 3 and 12M TPM by month 6.
- We'd like the discount tiers to be calibrated to achieved TPM, not calendar months. Example: 5% at sustained 6M TPM for 60 days, 12% at sustained 12M TPM for 60 days.

Attached: monthly-traffic-projections.xlsx (traffic curve we expect during pilot) — this will anchor acceptance gates.

Two asks: can you confirm pricing at those commit levels and provide a failure / rollback credit model if Redwood misses the SLA for two consecutive weeks? Also please confirm who will own the technical acceptance test (we propose Marissa as Redwood's lead, and Rahul on our side).

Thanks,
Linda Park
Director, Cloud Integrations
Ava Robotics

---
Attachment stubs: monthly-traffic-projections.xlsx (xlsx, 78KB)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Linda Park <linda@avarobotics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + TPM targets — initial ask

Linda — thanks for the clear asks and the projection workbook. Below is a working reproposal that tries to balance Ava's desire to limit early exposure while keeping the ramp economics predictable for both sides. High-level summary first, details below.

Summary (proposal):
- Pilot (months 1–2): 1.5M TPM soft-commit; unit price $0.00045/token; no prepayment required.
- Transition (month 3): if acceptance gates met, auto-increase to 6M TPM; unit price steps to $0.00038/token.
- Scale (months 4–6): linear ramp to 12M TPM by month 6 at $0.00030/token once 60-day sustained volumes are observed.
- Discount tranches tied to sustained TPM (aligned to your request): 5% @ sustained 6M TPM for 60 days; 12% @ sustained 12M TPM for 60 days. Discounts apply retroactively to the first day of the tranche once the 60-day window completes.
- SLA / credits: standard SLA credit formula applies. If p95 latency > 200ms for two consecutive weeks, Redwood issues a service credit equal to 10% of that month’s usage, capped at 30% for repeated misses. We can tighten to your 180ms threshold if Ava is willing to accept a smaller credit (8% cap).

Acceptance test owners: confirmed — Marissa will run the Redwood side validation harness with Rahul providing the ground-truth labels and traffic patterns. We’ll share the test harness repo and a runbook by Friday.

Attachments: I attached a revised MAP (Ava-MAP-v2.pdf) and a pricing table that maps token tiers to invoice lines. If this aligns, Ben will draft a one-page SOW and we can route to procurement / legal.

Next steps:
1) Let us know which SLA threshold you prefer (180ms vs 200ms).
2) Confirm the 1.5M TPM pilot — if confirmed, Ben will issue a pilot quote and we’ll schedule the acceptance runbook kickoff.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: Ava-MAP-v2.pdf (pdf, 132KB), redwood-pricing-commit-table.csv (csv, 12KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Linda Park <linda@avarobotics.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + TPM targets — pricing mechanics

Linda / Monica — quick follow-up on pricing mechanics and invoicing behavior during the staged ramp. A few clarifications and a small counter-proposal on discounts: 

- Pilot months billed at the pilot rate ($0.00045/token) with true-up when a higher tranche is earned (i.e., retroactive discount day one of the tranche after 60 days sustained).
- For the 6M TPM tranche, we can offer a 6% discount (vs 5%) if Ava signs a 12-month commitment term after month 3. This helps us justify the deeper kernel allocation.
- If Ava prefers to avoid a 12-month commitment, we can move the 6% -> 5% and preserve the 12% @ 12M TPM outcome as previously proposed.
- Failure / rollback credits: Redwood can include an additional fail-safe — if SLA misses result from infra capacity constraints (not customer traffic spikes), Redwood will provide a one-time migration credit equal to 15% of the impacted month and supply a capacity plan (GPU allocation) for the following 60 days.

If these mechanics read OK, I’ll include the pricing table and two signature lines (pilot SOW; annual commit amendment) and send to procurement.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rahul Singh <rahul@avarobotics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, linda@avarobotics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + TPM targets — pricing mechanics

Thanks — Ben / Monica. A couple of clarifying points from our infra/finance split: 

- We can accept the 1.5M TPM pilot rate but need a hard cap on overage exposure during months 1–2. Can Redwood cap billable tokens at 2.5M TPM for those months (i.e., if traffic spikes, we pay up to 2.5M at pilot rate, excess is waived or we throttle)?
- For SLA credits: we prefer credits to be applied as a true credit on the next invoice rather than retroactive cash refund.
- For the 12-month commitment option: we need the right to pause or reduce committed volume once per quarter with a 30-day notice and a reduced termination fee (3 months of committed spend) in case product fit diverges.

We’re broadly aligned on the tranche mechanics and the acceptance playbook — happy to set a kickoff for the runbook on Wednesday.

Best,
Rahul
CTO, Ava Robotics
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Rahul Singh <rahul@avarobotics.com>, Linda Park <linda@avarobotics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + TPM targets — pricing mechanics

Rahul / Linda — appreciate the clear asks. We can accept the majority of your guardrails with the following final adjustments so commercial and legal can move quickly: 

- Pilot overage cap: Redwood will cap billable tokens at 2.5M TPM for pilot months (1–2). Any consumption beyond that will be throttled by default; if Ava requests to lift throttling we will bill excess at pilot rate and cap at a hard stop of 3.5M TPM unless explicit approval is given.
- Credits application: agreed — credits will appear on the following invoice as a line item.
- 12-month commit clause: Redwood will include a quarterly adjustment right with one-time 60-day notice and a termination fee equal to 3 months of committed spend (agreed). We will explicitly exclude discounts already earned for historical periods.

Next steps: Ben will issue two documents by EOD Tuesday — (1) pilot SOW with acceptance runbook and (2) a one-page commitment amendment showing the 12-month option and discount levels. Marissa will ping Rahul to schedule the acceptance harness kickoff (Wednesday). If Ava confirms the pilot overage cap and quarterly adjustment clause, we’ll route to procurement / legal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the acceptance window started.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
